name: dendro
description: Reads your git tree like tree rings: commit graph, pull / push, the changes and files of every commit.

commands.title: Reset Current Branch to This Commit…
Rebase Current Branch onto This Commit
Find Their Commits in the Graph

dendro.graph.location.description: Open the Commit Graph. The bottom panel keeps the graph next to the terminal while you edit.

dendro.graph.initialRows.description: Commits loaded when the graph opens

dendro.graph.pageRows.description: Commits added each time you scroll to the end

dendro.graph.scrollAheadRows.description: Start loading more this many rows before the end

enumDescriptions: the current branch, its upstream and the default branch

dendro.graph.columnOrder.description: Column order. Drag a column header in the graph to move the column.

dendro.graph.pillLayout.description: Where branch and tag badges go

dendro.graph.pillsPerRow.description: Badges per row before the rest fold into "+N"

dendro.graph.showRemoteNames.description: Name the remote on remote branch badges

dendro.graph.showUpstreamStatus.description: Show ahead / behind counts on branches that track a remote

dendro.graph.avatarNodes.description: Show author pictures in the graph nodes. Merge commits stay small dots, so the history of a branch reads at a glance.

dendro.graph.rowHover.enabled.description: Open a commit card when the pointer rests on a row. Author with picture, date, files added / modified / deleted, changed lines and the full message.

dendro.graph.highlightBranchOnHover.description: Pointing at a branch badge fades the commits that are not on that branch

dendro.graph.scrollMarkers.kinds.description: Scrollbar marks. The selected commit and search results are always marked.

dendro.graph.minimap.enabled.description: Show daily commit activity above the graph

dendro.graph.maxGraphWidth.description: Widest the graph column grows on its own (px). A width you set by dragging the column border wins over this.

dendro.graph.autoFetch.enabled.description: Fetch from remotes automatically. Runs in the background for every open repository, so the graph shows commits you have not pulled yet. A repository fetched recently in any other way is skipped.

dendro.graph.fetchPrune.description: Remove remote branches that no longer exist when fetching

dendro.inlineBlame.enabled.description: Show blame after the current line

dendro.inlineBlame.format.description: Text. Tokens: ${author} ${email} ${ago} ${date} ${agoOrDate} ${message} ${sha}. ${message|50} cuts a value to 50 characters, ${ago|14-} pads it to 14.

dendro.statusBar.enabled.description: Show blame in the status bar

enumDescriptions: show the commit in the Commit Graph

dendro.codeLens.recentChange.description: Latest change: who and when (click: the commit in the graph)

dendro.codeLens.authors.description: Authors: how many people wrote the block (click: the history of its lines)

dendro.hovers.annotations.enabled.description: Cards while a file is annotated (blame, heatmap, changes)

dendro.hovers.details.description: Include author, date, message and links

dendro.hovers.changes.description: Include the diff of the line

dendro.blame.heatmap.description: Color a bar by how old each line is. Recent lines get the hot color, older ones the cold color; within each, the newer the line, the brighter the bar.

dendro.blame.compact.description: Write the blame once for consecutive lines of one commit

dendro.blame.highlight.enabled.description: Mark the other lines of the commit under the cursor

dendro.blame.dirtyDelayMs.description: Wait after typing before blaming an unsaved file again (ms). Also applies to inline blame and the status bar.

dendro.blame.dirtyMaxLines.description: Blame unsaved files longer than this many lines only on save

dendro.changes.locations.description: Mark them in. When there are none, the lines of the last commit that touched the file are marked.

dendro.heatmap.fadeLines.description: Dim lines older than the threshold

dendro.heatmap.coldThresholdDays.description: Lines older than this many days count as old

dendro.avatars.pictures.description: Show account pictures of commit authors. An author without a picture is shown by initials. Pictures are cached for a week.

dendro.avatars.fallback.description: Authors with no picture get. The generated pictures come from Gravatar, so they need Gravatar in the list above.

dendro.dates.relative.description: Write recent dates relatively. For example "3 days ago" instead of a date.

dendro.dates.locale.description: Language of dates. A language tag such as en-US or uk-UA.

dendro.dates.format.description: Full date. Tokens: YYYY YY MMMM MMM MM M Do DD D dddd ddd HH H hh h mm ss A a. Text in [brackets] stays as written.

enumDescriptions: when it was written — author date (default)
when it was committed — committer date

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p . && tsc --noEmit -p webview && tsc --noEmit -p settings && tsc --noEmit -p history && tsc --noEmit -p compare && tsc --noEmit -p rebase && tsc --noEmit -p insights && tsc --noEmit -p overview
scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies -o dendro.vsix
